concept.name: Recurrent neural network
concept.definition: A neural network for sequences that updates a hidden state from the current input and previous state, sharing parameters across time steps.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Process observations in order using h_t = activation(W_x x_t + W_h h_previous + b), then map states to outputs and train through time.
concept.formula: h_t = f(W_x x_t + W_h h_(t-1) + b)
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: A 30-day return sequence updates one hidden state per day and the final state predicts day 31 direction.
